entry.packaging: Normal top-level package/module entry; no sys.path mutation or dynamic import. The outside-cwd test supplies the repository as package search root. Production requires this namespace installed/sealed with bridge.py available as the regular file bound by config; zipapp inner-path handling is not claimed.
entry.wire: exact one bounded stdin request and one bounded stdout response; no live default authority

implemented.attempt_fence: An immutable per-intent attempt fence is O_EXCL+fsync before TrustedIo selection/admission, ORX creation, Git staging, or launch. Every dev/final attempted request counts. An unbound fence or native QUEUED/RUNNING/UNKNOWN blocks every later R1 including final.
implemented.context_permissions: Initial context forbids final and blocks new R1 after two actual eligible dev results. Continuation opens the root-hashed handoff, exact terminal controller receipt, and native session JSONL; campaign_usage rederives complete four-category usage below 120000 and exactly two eligible dev IDs plus saved research. It then persists one context admission so later normal research edits do not invalidate the verified handoff.
implemented.deployment: Root-hashed argo-house-price-a2-bridge-deployment/v1 binds bridge/python/orx/git file identities, seven directory identities, project/root-experiment/root-branch/base commit/fixed command/loopback port, runtime hashes, phase input FileBindings, exact production rows, allowlisted environment, scientific hashes, and context_rights.
implemented.dev_receipt: Native DONE plus strict runner-receipt/v1 is bound to execution config, runner/runtime, predictions, IDs, targets and native provenance. receipt_store.verify_dev_receipt independently regrades exact files; only the six-place aggregate MAE is published.
implemented.executor: Concrete BoundedSubprocessExecutor uses subprocess.Popen with shell=False, stdin=DEVNULL, fixed cwd and allowlisted exact environment; stdout+stderr aggregate is capped at 131072 bytes and each call has the fixed 3 second deadline. No diagnostic bytes are returned to the model.
implemented.final: Selection verifies a real eligible prior dev receipt. read_selected_code supplies the frozen historical bytes; current mutable solution is never staged. New final config binds selected closure/code with current final intent and contains no targets. Native DONE final predictions are reopened and ID-checked before artifact_sha256 appears in read_public_result.
implemented.limits: Campaign state enforces 3 dev metric opportunities, only 1 mechanically recognized pre-first-metric DOCKER_ERROR repair, 1 final refit, at most 4 dev attempts, and at most 5 total R1 requests. Unclassifiable failure consumes a metric opportunity rather than inventing repair rights.
implemented.lock: lock_final_artifact accepts exactly run_id and artifact_sha256, reopens the exact final file, calls frozen TrustedIo, publishes canonical FinalArtifactLock bytes once with O_EXCL+fsync, reopens them, and returns the canonical lock hash. A verified missing-publication crash window can be completed without a second TrustedIo effect; a duplicate completed lock returns FINAL_LOCKED.
implemented.native_get: StrictNativeGetter connects only to literal 127.0.0.1, sends GET with no auth/cookie, does not follow redirects or consult proxy environment, requires 200, and caps reads at 131072 bytes/3 seconds.
implemented.parent_mapping: Model parent_run_id/selected_run_id resolves through a persisted immutable Binding to its experiment_id and commit. Raw run UUID is never passed as the ORX parent experiment.
implemented.precreated_root: Bridge never creates an ORX project or service. First dev uses the root-precreated experiment and branch. Later dev/final experiments are fixed children.
implemented.pure_public_read: read_public_result writes no bridge state and never mirrors queued/running/terminal lifecycle locally.
implemented.source_archive: After the single fixed `orx exp run`, native GET and CLI status/runs must agree on run/experiment/project/commit/status/fixed command. The exact native sourcePath tar is opened bounded, its bytes hash to native sourceDigest, and its config, solution, and runtime members match the staged hashes.
implemented.staging: For each assigned experiment, fixed ORX status/runs and Git branch/commit/clean-tree preflight run before writes. The bridge writes only house-price-execution.json and house-price-solution.py, Git-adds those exact files, commits once, reopens Git blobs, and derives execution_config_sha256 from exact staged bytes. Config contains no future/self commit.
implemented.status_and_cancel: Binding records contain identity only, never lifecycle state. Every public read queries ORX. FixedNativePort.cancel requires one exact bound inflight run across GET/status/runs, issues fixed cancel argv, parses the expected run acknowledgement, then re-observes cancelRequested/CANCELLED.
